chunks: Saying what you do not practice is odious to God.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says 'Saying what you do not practice is odious to Him?'
ai.summary: Revealed in Surah As-Saff, this verse underscores the severity of hypocrisy by linking verbal inconsistency with divine anger, a theme frequently elaborated upon in Shia exegesis as a critique of religious leaders who neglect self-discipline. It serves as a foundational principle for the concept of 'Amal before Qawl' (action before speech), emphasizing that authentic leadership requires the alignment of one's practices with their teachings.
